explanation.zh-CN: header/nav/main/article/footer 表达结构角色，屏幕阅读器可据此生成地标导航；相比全 div 更易理解。本例为只读示例：App 内不运行浏览器。
explanation.en: header/nav/main/article/footer express structural roles that screen readers turn into landmark navigation, which is clearer than div soup. Read-only sample: no browser runs inside the app.

examples.expectedOutput: 页面出现 header/nav/main/article/footer 五个地标区域，标题层级从 h1 开始。

explanation.zh-CN: #featured .title 含 ID，权重高于 .card .title；.card:hover 只影响悬停状态。删除或降低不必要的高权重规则比叠加 !important 更好维护。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: #featured .title contains an ID and outweighs .card .title; .card:hover only affects the hover state. Removing unnecessary high specificity beats stacking !important. Read-only sample.

note.en: ID selectors have the highest weight

note.zh-CN: 类选择器组合权重较低

examples.expectedOutput: 标题同时命中两条规则时颜色取 #1a73e8，字重仍为 600。

explanation.zh-CN: box-sizing: border-box 时 width 包含 padding 与 border，元素总宽就是 200px，内容区实际为 156px。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: With box-sizing: border-box the width includes padding and border, so the element stays 200px and the content area is actually 156px. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 宽度包含内边距与边框

examples.expectedOutput: 卡片总占位宽 200px；内容区宽 200 - 20×2 - 2×2 = 156px。

explanation.zh-CN: justify-content 控制主轴对齐，align-items 控制交叉轴对齐，gap 设置子项间距。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: justify-content aligns along the main axis and align-items along the cross axis, while gap sets spacing between children. Read-only sample.

examples.expectedOutput: 子项在容器内水平垂直居中，相邻子项间距 12px。

explanation.zh-CN: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) 让列数随容器宽度自动变化，无需为每个断点写规则。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) changes the column count with container width, so no per-breakpoint rules are needed. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 列宽不小于 220px 且等分剩余空间
note.en: Columns are at least 220px and share the remaining space

examples.expectedOutput: 容器足够宽时一行放多张 220px 以上的卡片；变窄时列数减少且卡片不溢出。

explanation.zh-CN: 缺少 viewport 元标签时移动浏览器会按桌面宽度缩小渲染；加上后页面按设备宽度布局。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Without the viewport meta tag mobile browsers shrink a desktop layout; with it the page lays out at the device width. Read-only sample.

examples.code: 你好
examples.expectedOutput: 在移动设备上页面初始缩放为 1，布局宽度等于设备宽度，不出现横向滚动。

explanation.zh-CN: 默认样式按单列写，@media (min-width: 640px) 只负责增强为两列；顺序清晰且不需要回退覆盖。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The default styles describe one column and @media (min-width: 640px) only enhances to two columns, which keeps order clear with no override rollback. Read-only sample.

note.en: Single column by default on narrow screens

examples.expectedOutput: 视口小于 640px 时一行一张卡片；宽度达到 640px 后一行两张。

title.zh-CN: 用 rem 设置字号与间距
title.en: Using rem for type and spacing

explanation.zh-CN: 根字号设为 100%，正文 1rem、标题 1.5rem、间距 0.5rem 都随用户字号缩放。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The root font size is 100%, body text is 1rem, headings 1.5rem and spacing 0.5rem, so everything scales with the user font size. Read-only sample.

note.en: Keep the user's default root size
The heading scales with the root size

examples.expectedOutput: 浏览器字号调大后，正文、标题与间距同比放大且布局不破。

explanation.zh-CN: 深灰 #333333 配白底对比度足够；浅灰 #f5f5f5 配白底用于正文则明显不足，需要换深色或加粗放大。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Dark grey #333333 on white has enough contrast; light grey #f5f5f5 on white is clearly insufficient for body text and needs a darker color or larger bold text. Read-only sample.

note.en: Dark grey body text with sufficient contrast
Light grey text with insufficient contrast

examples.expectedOutput: .note 的正文达到 4.5:1 以上；.indicator 的 #f5f5f5 正文不达标，需要调整。

explanation.zh-CN: focus-visible 只在键盘导航时显示焦点环，既满足键盘用户又不影响鼠标点击的观感。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: focus-visible shows a focus ring for keyboard navigation while keeping mouse clicks clean. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 焦点环与按钮留出间距
note.en: Space between the ring and the button

examples.expectedOutput: 按 Tab 键聚焦按钮时出现清晰焦点环；鼠标点击时不出现焦点环。

explanation.zh-CN: 键盘用户按 Tab 第一下即可跳到主内容，避免每次都要穿过整排导航。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The first Tab moves keyboard users straight to the main content instead of walking through the whole navigation. Read-only sample.

note.en: Anchor link pointing at the main content

examples.expectedOutput: 页面加载后按 Tab，焦点先落在「跳到主内容」；回车后焦点与阅读位置移动到 main。

title.zh-CN: 给图标按钮补可访问名称
title.en: Adding an accessible name to an icon button

explanation.zh-CN: 只有图标的按钮需要 aria-label 说明用途；装饰性 svg 用 aria-hidden 避免被重复朗读。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: An icon-only button needs aria-label to explain its purpose, and a decorative svg should be aria-hidden so it is not announced twice. Read-only sample.

examples.code:
<button aria-label="关闭对话框" onclick="closeDialog()">
  <svg aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 1L9 9"/></svg>
</button>
examples.expectedOutput: 屏幕阅读器朗读「关闭对话框，按钮」，不朗读 svg 图形内容。

title.en: Deleting list items with event delegation

explanation.zh-CN: 监听器只绑在父容器上，通过 closest 找到被点按钮；动态新增的条目也自动生效。本例为只读示例：App 内不运行浏览器 JavaScript，仅做静态检查。
explanation.en: One listener on the parent uses closest to find the clicked button, so dynamically added rows work too. Read-only sample: browser JavaScript does not run inside the app; this is a static check.

note.zh-CN: 在父容器上只绑定一次
note.en: Bind once on the parent container
Find the real button by walking up

examples.expectedOutput: 点击任意删除按钮后该条目从列表移除，控制台无报错。

title.zh-CN: fetch 的成功与失败处理

explanation.zh-CN: fetch 只在网络层失败时 reject，HTTP 404 需要检查 response.ok 后自己抛错；response.json() 也可能解析失败。本例为只读示例：未在运行时验证，仅静态检查。
explanation.en: fetch rejects only on network failure, so a 404 needs an explicit response.ok check and your own error; response.json() may also fail to parse. Read-only sample: not executed at runtime, statically checked only.

note.zh-CN: HTTP 错误必须显式检查
note.en: HTTP errors must be checked explicitly

examples.expectedOutput: 接口返回 200 时打印用户数组；返回 404 时抛出 HTTP 404 错误；网络断开时由 try/catch 或 catch 分支处理。

title.zh-CN: 用 DevTools 收集样式证据

explanation.zh-CN: 这是一份证据清单而不是代码：每次修改样式后按顺序观察，才能说明「已生效」而不是「感觉生效」。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: This is an evidence checklist rather than code: after each style change, observe in order so you can prove it worked instead of assuming it did. Read-only sample.

examples.code:
检查清单：
1. Elements → Styles 里规则是否命中（被划掉表示覆盖）。
2. Computed 面板确认最终字体大小与颜色。
3. Network 面板看请求状态码与响应体。
4. Lighthouse/Accessibility 面板检查对比度与可访问名称。

note.zh-CN: 请求证据来自 Network 面板
note.en: Request evidence comes from the Network panel

note.zh-CN: 无障碍证据来自 Accessibility 面板
note.en: Accessibility evidence comes from the Accessibility panel

examples.expectedOutput: 四项都能给出实际观察结果（命中规则、计算值、状态码、对比度数值），而不是猜测。
